## What is this PR about?

Briefly explain what you changed and why. A few sentences are enough.

## Checklist

Before you open this PR, please confirm:

- This branch was created from `main`, not from another feature branch.
- I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (our CI checks this).
- I tested these changes locally. If you have not tested yet, please do so before submitting so reviewers do not spend time on unverified code.

## Related issues

If this PR fixes or relates to an issue, link it here (e.g. `Closes #123`). Otherwise write **N/A**.

## Screenshots

If this PR changes the UI, add screenshots or a short screen recording. Otherwise write **N/A**.
